# sugarcommerce/env

> 标签: configuration, dotenv, env, environment

## 简介

Environment configuration for plain PHP: .env parsing that handles quotes and multi-line values, typed accessors that fail loudly on a missing requirement, and no global mutation. Zero dependencies.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。
